title: Independent evidence for eVTOL certification and service readiness
question: What turns eVTOL demonstrations into certified commercial service?
why_it_matters: Company flight campaigns are useful signals, but commercial service depends on certification, operating approval, vertiports, insurance, local agreements, weather operations, and public trust.
current_support: FTFN has FAA AAM source context, an in-review FAA AAM signal, and a Draft Sample company-claim eVTOL signal.
next_action: Keep company flight campaigns as interested-party evidence until independent regulatory or local sources exist.
notes: Low priority because current MVP focus is local conversion evidence for energy, water, and housing.
